description: A four-stage envelope generator with a shape control and a built-in amplifier, in 2HP

params.text: Bends the envelope curve between exponential, gentle, linear and logarithmic, with the mid positions falling between them
Sets how long the rise takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the fall from full to the sustain level takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds at, 0% to 100%
Sets how long the fall to silence takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets the level of the built-in amplifier, 0% to 100%, and of the ENV output as well when 'LVL knob -> ENV out' is ticked

inputs.text: Opens the envelope: held high in Envelope mode, or a trigger in Function and Loop modes; its channel count sets the polyphony
The signal for the built-in amplifier

outputs.text: That signal at the envelope's level, scaled by the LVL knob

notes: the mode is chosen from the panel menu rather than a switch, and the small light above the jacks shows which: off for Envelope, red for Function, yellow for Loop.
menu: Envelope (off) — holds at the sustain level while the gate is high and releases when it falls
Function (red) — runs attack then decay from a trigger, without waiting for the gate to fall
Loop (yellow) — repeats attack and decay from a trigger until a second trigger sends it to release
LVL knob -> ENV out — makes the LVL knob attenuate the ENV output as well as the amplifier
Add Expander — places an eX expander to the right, giving the envelope another signal path
